name: routes_per_order_line
note: verifier: link read from the sale order line endpoint (sale.order.line.route_ids)
source_sql: SELECT sale_order_line_id, count(*) AS routes, max(stock_route_id) AS last_route FROM sale_order_line_stock_route_rel GROUP BY sale_order_line_id ORDER BY sale_order_line_id

name: order_lines_per_route
note: verifier: link read from the route endpoint (inverse of route_ids)
source_sql: SELECT stock_route_id, count(*) AS order_lines, min(sale_order_line_id) AS first_line FROM sale_order_line_stock_route_rel GROUP BY stock_route_id ORDER BY stock_route_id
